SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(SENT_AT, 'HH24')) FROM SMS_HISTORY
AND TRUNC(SENT_AT) = TO_DATE(#{searchDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT TO_CHAR(SENT_AT, 'HH24') || '시' AS timeSlot, COUNT(CASE WHEN SEND_STATUS = 'WAIT' THEN 1 END) AS sendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN SEND_STATUS = 'FAIL' THEN 1 END) AS failCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN SEND_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) AS successCount, COUNT(1) AS totalCount FROM SMS_HISTORY
AND TRUNC(SENT_AT) = TO_DATE(#{searchDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SENT_AT, 'HH24') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(SENT_AT, 'HH24')
